title: Chai UI: Brew AI Apps Fast
excerpt: The same UIs built into today's most powerful AI apps, now open source. One interface for every AI model, for React and Vue, running on Fal.ai, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway or your own engine.
content_html:
// A prompt bar for your AI app
import { useState } from "react";
import { Composer } from "@chai-ui/react";
import "@chai-ui/tokens/css";
import "@chai-ui/react/style.css";

export function PromptBar() {
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState("");
  return <Composer value={prompt} onChange={setPrompt} onSubmit={console.log} />;
}
